title: NOV-B1 commit #1 (before any search call)

corpus.tuned_ab_rule: argmin F over the first C* points of default_rng(20261025).permutation(3843); fixed at commit #2 when C* is fixed

arms.DTB: REQ1 48 tokens T1.0 logprobs 20; j = argmax top-20 entropy over eligible code tokens (earliest on ties); forced = uniform over allowed ranks 2-8; REQ2 continues at T1.0
arms.RPB: as DTB with j uniform over the same eligible set (rng [seed, arm_idx, call_id, 7])
arms.IDEA: T1.0 + one sentence: 'Write priority_v{k} based on an idea different from both functions above.' ('from the function above' for k=1)
arms.NS: T1.0, fixed parents FF (v0) and BF (v1), no database, offspring evaluated but never registered; runs after the main search, 40 rounds of 25 per seed
arms.vllm_seed: 32-bit sha256 hash of (seed, arm_idx, call_id); REQ2 adds 2

scheduler.eval: EvalPool 10 workers (13.6 vCPU cgroup minus vLLM and scheduler), SEL-OR+SEL-W, 10 s per set, fail fast, P1 probes 10 s, RLIMIT_AS 2 GiB, cache by normalise_key
scheduler.pause: after round 4 (100 calls per stream) until commit #2

c_star_ladder.L1: C*=2000 all five arms both seeds, NS 1000/seed after
c_star_ladder.floor: core arms 1000 on both seeds; hard stop governs
c_star_ladder.projection: remaining rounds x t_round x (active streams/10) + NS rounds x t_round x 0.2

drop_order: IDEA cut to 1000 then off (V6 with it)
never_drop: T1.0/T1.6/DTB/RPB on both seeds at matched calls >= 1000

verdict_rules.V1: best_a = better-by-F of arm a's two seed-bests (a in core); pass_a = exc_FSW5k <= 3.18744% and exc_OR3 <= 4.29423%; SUPPORTED iff all four pass; DISCONFIRMED iff no core arm meets the 0.8 rule on either set; else PARTIAL
verdict_rules.V2: D = complete-linkage clusters (all pairs agree >= 0.95) over valid offspring among calls 1..C_s; rate_a = 1000 (D_a0 + D_a1)/(C0 + C1); R1 = rate_DTB/rate_T1.0, R2 = rate_DTB/rate_T1.6, R3 = rate_DTB/rate_RPB; SUPPORTED iff R1 >= 1.5, R2 >= 1.5, all four per-seed D ratios vs T1.0/T1.6 > 1, R3 >= 1.2 and rho_DTB <= min(rho_T1.0, rho_T1.6); DISCONFIRMED iff R1 <= 1 or R2 <= 1; else PARTIAL. Paired round-block bootstrap B=2000 descriptive
verdict_rules.V3: candidates = min-F member of each of the 20 lowest-F behaviour clusters per arm-seed (no held-out data); NB = exc_FSW5k <= thr and exc_OR3 <= thr and max corpus agreement < 0.9; joint complete-linkage clusters at 0.95; best-F representative per joint cluster, <= 30 audited round-robin by F; NOVEL requires NB + both gated judges NOT_KNOWN + blind manual read finds no equivalent; KNOWN_FAMILY_NEW_PARAMETERS from any is its own non-novel class; SUPPORTED iff >= 1 NOVEL else DISCONFIRMED with rule-of-three bound; V3-strict adds max agreement < 0.9 vs all 3,843 ab-grid points
verdict_rules.V6: rename(child) = max agreement with its prompt parent(s) >= 0.95 over valid offspring pooled across seeds; SUPPORTED iff rate_IDEA >= 0.4 and rate_IDEA >= rate_T1.0 - 0.1; DISCONFIRMED iff rate_IDEA < 0.2; else PARTIAL; Wilson + Newcombe CIs; comment regex new|novel|different|alternative|instead|unlike|another approach|fresh

calibration.statement: A pair that 2510.27353 calls one principle agrees below 0.9: the 0.9 probe rule is NOT selective there, so the judges, the manual read and V3-strict carry V3.

expected_throughput.machine: RTX 4090 24 GB, 13.6 vCPU, 56 GB; KV cache 90,656 tokens; no CUDA graphs (-O0 skipped capture)
